design: four serial pairs, alternating runtime order. 60s settle, one warm-up, five measured trials. Pair 1 AVD was already running over 60s before warm-up.
primary_speed: monotonic walltime of complete Meer login → Search → Home Detox test body
primary_memory: runtime process PSS plus SwapPSS immediately after each completed trial
system_images: Android 15 x86_64. AVD Google APIs and ReDroid AOSP; separate software renderer builds.
android_accounting: deployment comparison under the same CPU affinity. MemTotal and CPU topology seen by Android differ, and AVD has no independent two-core quota. Both can schedule on two cores.
success: all trials pass, identical input and feed coordinates per matched arm, lower per-boot median time and memory across pairs
statistics: Median (midpoint for even n). Nearest-rank p95. Report raw inner samples and paired boot-level results.
